metadata.name: jpui-animated-icon
metadata.description: An animated line icon (Lucide style, animations ported from lucide-animated). It plays by itself when the button, link or menu item around it is clicked or hovered, follows a bound boolean, or plays from workflow actions. Drawn with currentColor, so it takes the text color of its container unless `color` is set.
features: Plays on click or hover of its host (nearest button, link, [role=button], [role=menuitem], or a custom selector) with no workflow
Keyboard parity: Enter / Space click the host, focus plays the hover animation
State mode: moves to the animated pose while `active` is true
Spring motion, retargetable mid-flight (hover out halfway, click again)
currentColor by default; size, color and stroke width in the style panel
Disabled host (disabled or aria-disabled) does not play

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: What plays the animation. 'click' = a click on the host goes to the animated pose and comes back; 'hover' = animated while the pointer (or keyboard focus) is on the host; 'state' = animated while `active` is true; 'manual' = only the play / start / stop actions.

properties.name: hostSelector
properties.description: CSS selector of the ancestor that plays the icon in click / hover mode. Empty = the nearest button, link, [role=button], [role=menuitem], [role=link] or [role=tab]; if none, the icon's parent element.

properties.name: active
properties.description: State mode only: true = animated pose, false = rest.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Accessible name. Leave empty when the icon sits in a named button: the icon is then hidden from screen readers.

properties.name: size
properties.description: CSS length of the icon box (width and height). Element width / height set in the style panel win over it.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Stroke color. Empty = currentColor (the text color around the icon).

properties.name: strokeWidth
properties.description: Line thickness on the 24×24 grid (Lucide default 2).

events.name: animationStart
events.description: The icon starts moving from rest. `event.state` = the pose it heads to ('animate' or 'normal').

events.name: animationEnd
events.description: The icon comes to rest. `event.state` = the pose it rests on.

actions.label: Play (go and come back)
actions.description: Same as a click: animated pose, short hold, back to rest (or to the Active pose in state mode).

actions.label: Start (go to the animated pose)
actions.description: Move to the animated pose and stay there.

specifications: Click and hover are listened to on the front document in capture phase, then matched against the host, so the host needs no workflow and a stopPropagation inside it does not block the icon.
A click while playing restarts from the current position (spring retargeting, no jump).
With prefers-reduced-motion, click does nothing; hover, state and actions jump to the pose without motion.

examples.description: Trash icon inside a delete button: plays when the button is clicked.
Trash icon in a menu item that closes on click: play on hover instead, so the animation is seen.
